title: Gerente de Investigação Forense
description:
Este grupo multinacional líder, com operações significativas nas Américas e em todo o mundo, busca um Gerente de Investigação Forense experiente para liderar uma equipe de investigadores corporativos em suas operações regionais.


Sediado em Belo Horizonte, você será responsável por gerir uma equipe de especialistas forenses e supervisionar investigações de crimes financeiros complexos, incluindo conflitos de interesse, fraudes em compras e suprimentos, apropriação indébita de ativos, má gestão financeira, corrupção e suborno.


Sua função será focada primordialmente na liderança da equipe, definindo objetivos estratégicos de desempenho e construindo relacionamentos para garantir a fluidez das operações regionais. Você terá a responsabilidade diária pela gestão dos especialistas forenses, fornecendo orientação para o desenvolvimento de carreira e supervisionando a alocação de recursos. Além disso, você será o principal ponto de contato para a gestão operacional, desempenhando um papel fundamental na estratégia geral dos objetivos de investigação do grupo.


Somado às funções de liderança, você conduzirá projetos de investigação corporativa de alto nível, ministrará treinamentos de conscientização sobre fraudes e supervisionará a integração de ferramentas de análise de dados (data analytics) nos fluxos de trabalho investigativos.


Para ter sucesso nesta função, é fundamental possuir sólida experiência na condução de investigações corporativas complexas e na gestão de equipes forenses especializadas. Provavelmente, você já atua em um cargo de gerência em uma consultoria forense ou em uma função similar no setor corporativo.

Embora a certificação CFE seja muito bem-vinda, valorizamos sua capacidade comprovada de liderar equipes de alto desempenho e gerenciar o relacionamento com stakeholders seniores.


Excelentes habilidades de comunicação são essenciais, sendo obrigatória a fluência em português e inglês. Conhecimento em espanhol e experiência com ferramentas avançadas de análise de dados serão considerados diferenciais significativos


Para mais informações, assista ao nosso video

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Pessoa Estagiária em Inteligência de Negócios
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar nos processos de Gestão da Inadimplência (recebimento de informações dos shoppings, consolidação de dados e indicadores, análises pontuais solicitadas pela Diretoria)
  • Apoiar na construção de planilhas e materiais para realização de treinamentos junto aos shoppings
  • Apoiar a construção de especificação dos projetos na área como programas de engajamento, construção de ferramentas, atualização e melhorias nos processos existentes
  • Atuar de forma pró-ativa com as demais áreas (Jurídico, CSC, Régua de Cobrança, Faturamento, TI, Contas a Receber, Fornecedores e etc)
  • Apoiar na construção e atualização de Calendários, rotinas e rituais da área
  • Apoiar no atendimento de dúvidas, solicitações dos shoppings ao time de Inteligência de Negócios

Requisitos e qualificações


  • Superior cursando em Administração, Economia, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento intermediário no Pacote Office, sendo Excel e ferramentas de BI considerados diferenciais.

Apply with your CV in English.

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.




Important Candidate Notice : On January 9, 2026, CommScope finalized the sale of its Connectivity and Cable Solutions segment, which included the CommScope name and brand, to Amphenol Corporation. The remaining businesses — Access Networks Solutions (now rebranded as Aurora Networks ) and RUCKUS Networks have been unified under the new parent company, renamed as Vistance Networks . The role being advertised is part of RUCKUS Networks.


Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.


Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

  • Ensure efficient data retrieval and high-performance query execution.


DevOps & Engineering Excellence

Collaboration & Agile Development

Required Qualifications

description:

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.

  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.

  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

description:

Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.


You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.


This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines


If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: Atendente comercial
description:
Título da vaga: Atendimento Comercial (PJ) | Fotografia Pet

Modelo:  Híbrido – Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Regime: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

Horário:  seg–sab, 9h–17h 

Início:  Imediato

​Descrição da Empresa:

A Pedaço de Céu Foto Pet é um estúdio especializado em fotografia pet e família multiespécie, criado para transformar vínculos reais em memórias que atravessam o tempo.

Acreditamos que cada pet tem uma essência única e que o amor entre tutores e seus companheiros merece ser registrado com sensibilidade, calma e respeito.

Nosso trabalho vai além de “fotos bonitas”: entregamos uma experiência afetiva, conduzida com acolhimento e um olhar atento aos detalhes, ao comportamento e ao conforto do animal.

Cada ensaio é planejado de forma personalizada, para que o resultado traduza verdade, conexão e história. 


Objetivo da função

Ser a pessoa responsável por converter leads em sessões agendadas , com atendimento rápido, consultivo e com follow-up consistente, fazendo prospecção ativa com a base de clientes recorrentes.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atender leads via WhatsApp/Instagram/Telefone com rapidez e clareza.
  • Fazer qualificação (perfil do tutor, tipo de pet, objetivo, disponibilidade, urgência).
  • Apresentar pacotes/condições e conduzir a negociação até o fechamento.
  • Agendar sessões e coordenar agenda com a equipe desde o início até a entrega final das fotos.
  • Registrar tudo em CRM/planilha (etapa do lead, motivo de perda, status do pagamento).
  • Fazer follow-up diário dos leads abertos.
  • Garantir o básico do pós-venda: confirmação de sessão, checklist do cliente, alinhamento de expectativas.
  • Sinalizar gargalos para o marketing (objeções recorrentes, etapas que travam conversão).

Indicadores de sucesso (KPIs)

  • Tempo de primeira resposta: meta de 5 minutos em horário comercial.
  • Taxa de conversão Lead → Agendamento/Fechamento: meta de 15%
  • Follow-up diário: 90% de leads sem ficar “parado”.
  • Organização do funil: 100% dos leads com etapa definida e motivo de perda registrado.

Requisitos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com atendimento comercial (WhatsApp/DM) e fechamento .
  • Escrita objetiva e profissional (sem enrolação, sem “texto pronto genérico”).
  • Organização para trabalhar com funil, agenda e rotina de follow-up .
  • Conforto com metas e remuneração variável.
  • Equipamento e internet para trabalho (nos dias remotos).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com negócios de serviço/agenda (estética, saúde, fotografia, eventos).
  • Experiência com CRM (Canva, Notion, Trello, etc.).

Remuneração (PJ)

  • Fixo mensal: R$ 1.800,00
  • Comissão por meta de faturamento

Processo seletivo

  • Triagem pelo
  • Conversa rápida (15–20 min)
  • Teste prático simples (organização de funil + simulação de atendimento)
  • Entrevista final com sócios

Como se candidatar

Enviar (currículo/) + uma mensagem curta respondendo:

  • Qual sua experiência com atendimento e vendas por WhatsApp?
  • Qual resultado/indicador você já bateu em função comercial?

title: Template Designer Intern
description:
Na Cape.io, não estamos apenas acompanhando o ritmo da indústria publicitária. Estamos acelerando-o.


Somos uma empresa global de tecnologia com a missão de eliminar o atrito entre o criativo e a mídia. A Cape.io é a primeira plataforma de Automação Inteligente de Campanhas a unificar todo o ciclo de vida de uma campanha. Ao integrar IA e conformidade (compliance) automatizada desde a concepção criativa até a ativação, capacitamos marcas a lançar campanhas de alto impacto e dentro das normas com velocidade e inteligência sem precedentes.


Nossa plataforma conta com a confiança das principais agências e anunciantes do mundo para controlar e distribuir conteúdo publicitário em mais de 100 países. Com mais de 230 funcionários em 21 escritórios — de Londres às Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico — estamos mudando fundamentalmente a forma como a publicidade funciona.


O que você fará

Como Estagiário(a) de Template Design, você ajudará a criar e otimizar templates para clientes. Você participará de projetos de onboarding criativo e auxiliará no treinamento de novos clientes que utilizam nossa ferramenta self-service de Template Designer. Além disso, você será um ponto de contato para suporte e dúvidas técnicas sobre a ferramenta.

Durante seu estágio, você aprenderá:


  • Como construir templates dinâmicos para diversos clientes globais.
  • Como guiar novos clientes através do processo de onboarding criativo.
  • Como fornecer treinamento especializado e suporte técnico sobre nossa ferramenta de design.


O que você traz (Perfil desejado)

  • Formação: Você está cursando ensino superior ou se formou recentemente em áreas correlatas (Design, Publicidade, Marketing,, etc.).
  • Experiência em Design: Familiaridade com ferramentas como Photoshop, InDesign, Figma ou softwares similares.
  • Familiarizado com Automação: Você gosta de otimizar processos e torná-los mais eficientes através da tecnologia.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Você gosta de interagir com pessoas, dar treinamentos e solucionar dúvidas de clientes.
  • Idiomas: Português nativo e proficiência em Inglês e Espanhol.
  • Atenção aos detalhes: Você tem um olhar apurado para design e garante que todos os templates tenham acabamento profissional.
  • Vontade de crescer: Mentalidade curiosa e motivação para desenvolver novas habilidades técnicas e de atendimento ao cliente.


Sobre nossa solução de automação criativa

  • O desafio: Gargalos criativos e operações manuais de Ad Ops geram sobrecarga nas equipes e prejudicam a performance das campanhas. O ciclo infinito de revisões impede que as marcas escalem o que realmente funciona.
  • Nossa solução: Construímos uma plataforma all-in-one para produzir, personalizar e lançar anúncios de alta performance em todos os canais — de redes sociais e display a vídeo e DOOH. Unificamos os fluxos de criação e mídia, permitindo que marcas passem de um único criativo mestre para variações ilimitadas em minutos.
  • Seu impacto: Você estará no coração da nossa missão de libertar a criatividade. Você capacitará nossos clientes a superar a concorrência através de ferramentas que transformam dados em anúncios personalizados de alto impacto em escala.


Nosso DNA: Como trabalhamos

Nossos valores são os princípios que guiam nossas decisões e interações todos os dias:

  • Mova-se com inteligência (Move smart): A hesitação mata o ritmo. Combinamos velocidade com inteligência, transformando desafios complexos em soluções automatizadas.
  • Defina o amanhã (Define tomorrow): Não estamos aqui para atender expectativas, mas para redefini-las. Buscamos qualidade, segurança e escala sem precedentes.
  • Melhores juntos (Be better together): O sucesso se multiplica quando compartilhado. Através da colaboração aberta e apoio mútuo, transformamos potencial individual em conquista coletiva.
  • Mude o que é possível (Change what’s possible): A criatividade impulsiona a humanidade. Nossa tecnologia existe para amplificá-la e permitir que ela decole.

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams


Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

description:
Sobre a vaga:


Operamos em duas frentes: a Plataforma Unificada de Pessoas, voltada a People Analytics e diagnóstico organizacional, e projetos de consultoria estratégica baseados em dados para grandes marcas globais. No lado de consultoria, construímos plataformas de analytics, modelos preditivos e camadas de IA generativa que alimentam decisões comerciais de alto nível, incluindo projetos para CPGs com presença em toda a América Latina.


Estamos contratando um(a) profissional sênior para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, modelagem e IA em produção. O escopo é amplo por design: somos pequenos. Não há um engenheiro dedicado só a pipelines e outro só a modelagem. Você faz os dois, e precisa saber quando priorizar cada frente. O trabalho de consultoria é concreto: pegar dados de múltiplas fontes (sell-in, sell-out, P&L, market share, distribuição), estruturar pipelines que não quebrem toda semana, construir modelos que vão para produção de verdade, e desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa sobre esses dados. A plataforma interna de People Analytics caminha em paralelo, com modelagem de diagnóstico organizacional e integração de LLMs nos fluxos de produto.



Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e orquestrar pipelines de dados (BigQuery, GCP) com monitoramento real;
  • Harmonizar múltiplas fontes com nomenclaturas inconsistentes e atualizações diárias;
  • Construir modelos preditivos (XGBoost/LightGBM) e simuladores de cenário;
  • Colocar ML em produção: APIs (FastAPI), versionamento (MLflow, DVC), monitoramento de drift;
  • Desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa usando RAG, Vertex AI e LangChain;
  • Trabalhar direto com produto, tech lead e fundador — e eventualmente apresentar resultados para executivos de clientes globais.



Requisitos:


  • Superior completo em Ciência da computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de software ou áreas afins;
  • Python sólido e SQL avançado;
  • GCP na prática: BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Run;
  • Orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect ou similar) — não só saber o que é, mas ter feito;
  • ML em produção de verdade, não apenas notebooks;
  • Familiaridade com LLMs, RAG e LangChain;
  • Experiência com Metabase ou ferramenta de BI equivalente para entrega de insights a stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura técnica, documentação e contexto com clientes;
  • Perfil autônomo: sabe definir própria agenda dentro de objetivos claros.


Perfil valorizado: Quem já trabalhou com dados de negócio fora de grandes empresas de tecnologia — CPG, varejo, RH, mercado financeiro. A lógica de sell-in/sell-out, P&L e market share não é óbvia para todo mundo. Se você já navegou nesses contextos, vai se adaptar muito mais rápido.

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
  • Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
  • Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem


This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

title: Over-the Counter (OTC) Sales Specialist
description:
Mackay Marine is a global marine electronics service company with more than 500 employees across 60 service depots in twenty-two (22) countries, including the America's, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Mackay offers competitive salaries plus overtime, and benefits such as health/dental insurance, holiday leave, meal and transportation vouchers are available as well.

Mackay is currently seeking a fulltime and experienced Marine Over the Counter (OTC) Specialist who is proficient in English, to work onsite at our Rio location. Individuals with the skills and qualifications outlined below are encouraged to apply.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB SUMMARY

The OTC Specialist is an onsite, non-managerial position which reports to the Managing Director for Brazil. The responsibilities of the OTC Specialist include but are not limited to communicating directly with our customers to answer questions concerning the availability, price, and use of merchandise as well as providing technical guidance, timely quotations, and comprehensive proposals. Will process over-the-counter transactions, special orders, phone-in and internet sales orders as well as inter-company transfers. Will support other team members, customers and company accounts with parts ordering and fulfillment to support our business.

Responsibilities will also include material handling and shipping/receiving of goods which includes physical lifting, handling of boxes, pallet jacks and may include activities on ladders, lifts, forklift, power tools, hand tools, carrying and moving of parts and equipment.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Acts as the point of contact for customer sales, service, and information requests to ensure that customer needs are fulfilled with speed and professionalism.
  • Assist in the research of basic technical issues on products and service. Collect symptoms of customer problems and facilitate repairs.
  • Assist with incoming sales prospects or customer calls when outside sales staff are out of the office.
  • Provide customer quotes, proposals, and will follow up in a timely manner.
  • Build the business by identifying revenue opportunities within the marine industry.
  • Assist with the shipping and receiving functions to help facilitate the trafficking and accountability for all materials received and delivered for customer orders, inventory, repairs, or for internal use.
  • Direct service requests the appropriate team member.
  • Maintain work area and stockroom in a clean and orderly fashion.
  • Read customer orders, work orders, shipping orders, or requisitions to determine items to be moved, gathered, or distributed and/or shipped using Mackay’s ERP system.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST SKILLS NEEDED:

  • Prior knowledge of Marine electronic equipment is a plus.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as product brochures, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, etc.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percentage.
  • Attention to detail and ability to organize materials effectively and efficiently.
  • Excellent customer service, communication (both oral and written), organizational, planning, and prioritization skills.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Two years of post-secondary education.
  • Electronics and/or marine background preferred.
  • Three years of inside or counter sales experience.
  • Good computer and Internet skills
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.


Applicants must be authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship.  Successful completion of a thorough background check will be required upon acceptance of an employment offer.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:

You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker.   • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .

  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us

As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

RESUMO DA VAGA DE ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS NO BALCÃO (OTC)

O Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) é um cargo presencial, sem função gerencial, que se reporta ao Diretor Geral do Brasil. As responsabilidades do Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) incluem, entre outras, a comunicação direta com nossos clientes para responder a perguntas sobre disponibilidade, preço e uso de produtos, bem como fornecer orientação técnica, orçamentos em tempo hábil e propostas abrangentes. Processará transações no balcão, pedidos especiais, pedidos de vendas por telefone e internet, bem como transferências entre empresas. Dará suporte a outros membros da equipe, clientes e contas da empresa com pedidos e entrega de peças para apoiar nossos negócios.

As responsabilidades também incluirão manuseio de materiais e envio/recebimento de mercadorias, o que envolve levantamento físico, manuseio de caixas, paleteiras e pode incluir atividades em escadas, elevadores, empilhadeiras, ferramentas elétricas, ferramentas manuais, transporte e movimentação de peças e equipamentos.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO DE ESPECIALISTA EM ATENDIMENTO NO BALCÃO:

• Atuar como ponto de contato para vendas, serviços e solicitações de informações do cliente para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas com rapidez e profissionalismo.

• Auxiliar na pesquisa de problemas técnicos básicos sobre produtos e serviços. Coletar sintomas de problemas do cliente e facilitar os reparos.

• Auxiliar no atendimento de clientes em potencial ou ligações de clientes quando a equipe de vendas externas estiver fora do escritório.

• Fornecer orçamentos e propostas aos clientes e realizar o acompanhamento em tempo hábil.

• Desenvolver o negócio identificando oportunidades de receita no setor náutico.

• Auxiliar nas funções de expedição e recebimento para facilitar o fluxo e a contabilização de todos os materiais recebidos e entregues para pedidos de clientes, estoque, reparos ou uso interno.

• Direcionar solicitações de serviço ao membro da equipe apropriado.

• Manter a área de trabalho e o estoque limpos e organizados.

• Ler pedidos de clientes, ordens de serviço, ordens de envio ou requisições para determinar os itens a serem movidos, coletados, distribuídos e/ou enviados, utilizando o sistema ERP da Mackay.

HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS PARA ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS DE PRODUTOS DE BANCADA:

• Conhecimento prévio de equipamentos eletrônicos náuticos é um diferencial.

• Capacidade de ler e interpretar documentos como folhetos de produtos, instruções de operação e manutenção, manuais de procedimentos, etc.

• Capacidade de somar, subtrair, multiplicar e dividir em todas as unidades de medida, utilizando números inteiros, frações comuns e decimais. Capacidade de calcular taxas, proporções e porcentagens.

• Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de organizar materiais de forma eficaz e eficiente.

• Excelentes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente, comunicação (oral e escrita), organização, planejamento e priorização.

QUALIFICAÇÕES PARA ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS DE MEDICAMENTOS DE BANCADA:

• Dois anos de ensino superior.

• Experiência na área de eletrônica e/ou náutica é desejável.

• Três anos de experiência em vendas internas ou no balcão.

• Bons conhecimentos de informática e internet.

• Carteira de habilitação válida e veículo próprio.

Os candidatos devem estar autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil sem necessidade de patrocínio. A aprovação em uma verificação completa de antecedentes será exigida após a aceitação da oferta de emprego.

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!
